top_paper.title: Xiaomi-Lens-0 Technical Report
top_paper.summary: Xiaomi-Lens-0 is a 4B multimodal model that predicts masks from internal visual representations to improve fine-grained region reasoning and referring comprehension.

papers.title: DeOverlay: A Benchmark and Source-Anchored Flow for Video Overlay Removal
papers.summary: DeOverlay uses source-anchored flow matching and visibility-normalized temporal aggregation to remove video overlays while preserving scene structure, and introduces DVTE-Bench for standardized evaluation.

papers.title: HarnessPro: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement with Pareto Optimization for Performance-Cost Trade-offs
papers.summary: HarnessPro evolves AI agent harnesses without labels to boost task success and lower execution costs, yielding lightweight, balanced, and high-performance variants via trajectory diagnosis and weighted selection.

papers.title: Co-Evolving Acting and Forecasting for Language Agents
papers.summary: CoPE improves agentic reinforcement learning by training policies to generate multi-step action sequences from trajectory histories, increasing sample efficiency without inference overhead.

papers.title: RSIFlow: Adaptive Self-Improvement Workflows with an Evolving Meta-Agent
papers.summary: RSIFlow is a recursive self-improvement framework that dynamically selects component-specific workflows based on execution feedback and evolves a meta-agent to refine orchestration and skills.

papers.title: ScaleNav: Scalable Internet Video Pretraining for Language-Conditioned Local Navigation
papers.summary: ScaleNav learns goal-directed visual dynamics from internet egocentric videos to generate robot actions for language-conditioned local navigation, achieving high success rates in simulation and real-world deployment.

papers.title: Empowering Edge Agents: A Systematic Analysis of Edge-Cloud Collaboration in LLM Agent Execution
papers.summary: EC2-Bench evaluates edge-cloud collaboration for long-horizon LLM agents, revealing trade-offs among performance, resource use, and privacy, and showing that stronger edge models favor more edge-controlled collaboration.

papers.title: OR-License: Evaluating LLM Agents as Real-World Operations Research Practitioners
papers.summary: OR-License evaluates whether LLM agents can solve real-world operations research problems from original client materials, finding that while some achieve high objective quality, none match expert-level feasibility and deployment-adjusted quality.

papers.title: RoAR-VAE: Improving Latent Diffusability through Robust Prediction
papers.summary: RoAR-VAE improves visual tokenizers by enforcing robust prediction of semantics and reconstruction from corrupted latents, balancing fidelity with diffusion learnability.

papers.title: Learning to Discriminate Scene Structures Makes Self-Supervised Depth Learning Scalable
papers.summary: The MaSS framework improves self-supervised monocular depth estimation across diverse scenes by separating structural representations from contextual features and using a scene-structure discrimination objective, enabling scalable mixed-domain training and strong zero-shot generalization.

papers.title: Frechet Forcing: Training Long-Horizon Streaming World Models from Short Clips
papers.summary: Fréchet Forcing fine-tunes streaming video world models using self-generated rollouts and real-data statistics to prevent long-horizon drift without requiring teachers or long videos.

papers.title: Self-Evolving Coding Agents via Harness-Policy Optimization
papers.summary: Self-HPO is a recursive framework that alternates harness and policy optimization for coding agents, improving performance by targeting evolving failure modes through reinforcement learning.

papers.title: World Model Interpretability: From Decoding Representations to Understanding Latent Worlds
papers.summary: JEPA latent-world interpretability should shift from decoding representations to analyzing how latent variables interact, evolve, and causally drive prediction through grounding, structuring, verifying, and acting.

papers.title: Self-Evaluating Recursive Agents
papers.summary: SERA trains recursive language agents to generate evaluation rubrics for subtasks, improving decomposition, solving, and self-evaluation with reduced external supervision.

papers.title: MT Forcing: Towards Stable and Consistent Multi-Turn Image Editing with Autoregressive Diffusion
papers.summary: MT Forcing improves multi-turn image editing by combining single-turn distribution matching distillation and teacher-forcing guidance to stabilize visual quality and preserve cross-turn consistency.

papers.title: TokenEconomizer: Experience-Driven Black-Box Cost Control for Coding Agents
papers.summary: TokenEconomizer reduces recurring token costs of coding agents across sequential real-world tasks by pruning irrelevant tools, injecting micro-skills, and interrupting failure loops.

papers.title: Robust Explanatory Analysis for Structured Optimization Networks (REASON) in Learning
papers.summary: A two-loop inference framework resolves residual errors via fast and evidence-seeking loops to improve robustness under distribution shift with lower computation.

papers.title: Recognition Is Not Grounding: Benchmarking Multilingual Financial Evidence Extraction
papers.summary: The study introduces MULTIFINGROUND, a multilingual benchmark showing that language models recognize financial concepts across languages but frequently fail to recover all corresponding numerical evidence.

papers.title: BRACE: Adapting Whole-Body References for Force and Terrain Aware Humanoid Motion Tracking
papers.summary: BRACE is a whole-body humanoid tracker that integrates commanded hand forces and terrain adaptation by transforming references and distilling teachers into a proprioceptive flow-matching policy.

papers.title: DisaggKD: Efficient Knowledge Distillation through Teacher-Student Disaggregation and a Fused Loss
papers.summary: Knowledge distillation (KD) frameworks place teacher and student on the same GPUs, so per-GPU memory limits the teachers that fit. DisaggKD separates them across nodes: teacher replicas stream hidden states to the student, a KD loss over row windows and vocabulary shards equals the full-vocabulary loss in exact arithmetic without forming the full-vocabulary logits, and a prefetch ring paces producer and trainer. papers.title: Lean4AgenticRL: Advancing Agentic RL with Verifiable Multi-level Process Rewards
papers.summary: Lean4AgenticRL integrates multi-level process rewards into a Lean4 formalization framework to improve agentic reinforcement learning for software engineering and terminal tasks, yielding stronger model performance.

papers.title: EvoWeb: A Benchmark for Coding Agents on Evolving Web Applications
papers.summary: Web application development often proceeds through successive requests that extend an existing implementation. Yet web-generation benchmarks primarily evaluate development toward fixed specifications. We introduce EvoWeb, a novel benchmark comprising 320 cumulative requests over 32 web applications, grounded in real-world product features and structured by functional dependency graphs. papers.title: OmniXRef: A Unified Framework for Multimodal Multi-Reference Video Editing
papers.summary: Creative intent in video editing can be expressed through text instructions (e.g., "remove the people"), image references (e.g., subject appearance), video references (e.g., camera movement), or a combination of the above. We introduce OmniXRef, a unified framework for multimodal multi-reference video editing that allows users to combine variable numbers of text, image, and video references to control diverse attributes of a source video. papers.title: Librarian Agents: Training LLMs to Curate Long-Context Workspaces that Anticipate Future Queries
papers.summary: Librarian Agents use reinforcement learning to train builder agents that reorganize document corpora into reusable hierarchical workspaces, improving downstream reasoning accuracy and amortizing costs across queries.

papers.title: GlobeBench: Evaluating Text-Based World Model Capabilities for Scalable Environment Simulations
papers.summary: GlobeBench introduces a standardized benchmark of 1,632 tasks across five domains to evaluate text-based world models, revealing that current LLMs struggle with propagating action effects across dependent objects.

papers.title: Relational Learning as World Modeling
papers.summary: Relational learning typically predicts from a database state, but decision making asks a different question: how will that state change under an action? In operational systems, the answer depends on system-specific dynamics that may not be visible in the database itself. We view each such system as a relational "world" and ask whether a model can infer how it behaves from observed executions. We introduce TabWM (Tabular World Model) and WorldRel, a generator of executable relational worlds for pretraining. papers.title: What It Is, Not What It Says: Securing Agentic Browsing Interactions with Web Semantics
papers.summary: Intact protects AI web agents by isolating webpage elements via provenance-aware representations and enforcing capability-bound execution with user consent for third-party actions.

papers.title: ARC-SORT: Adaptive, Robust, Compensated Multi-Object Tracking with Interacting Multiple Models
papers.summary: ARC-SORT improves multi-object tracking in sports broadcasts by using adaptive uncertainty-based search regions, corrective identity swaps, and appearance-only re-identification to achieve high accuracy with minimal identity switches.

papers.title: AI-Driven Disaster Response and Displacement Monitoring
papers.summary: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (AI) has demonstrated its potential across a wide range of humanitarian tasks, offering scalable and data-driven solutions to some of the world's most pressing challenges. For instance, in addressing climate change, AI-powered models are being used for faster and more accurate global weather forecasting, control and design of renewable energy, and monitoring deforestation. papers.title: Xiaomi-Lens-0 Technical Report
papers.summary: Xiaomi-Lens-0 is a 4B multimodal model that predicts masks from internal visual representations to improve fine-grained region reasoning and referring comprehension.

papers.title: MTEdit: Packed Trajectories Beat Rollouts for Multi-Turn Image Editing
papers.summary: MTEdit is a large-scale multi-turn image editing dataset using packed trajectory canvas generation to reduce visual drift, enabling improved multi-turn editing models evaluated on MTEdit-Bench.
